Add a POST endpoint to create a verification challenge (CTF style). Hide flags in proofs. Reward. Return 201.

task_id: add-verification-challenge-endpoint
summary: "Add a POST endpoint to create a CTF-style verification challenge, hide flags in proofs, and reward participants"
depends_on: ["stage-1-core-models", "stage-2-auth-middleware"]
local_goals:
  - id: L1
    description: "INSPECT: check existing challenge model and routes before adding new endpoints"
    verification:
      type: file_exists
      path: "src/models/Challenge.ts"
      expect:
        exists: true
  - id: L2
    description: "CREATE: add POST /v1/challenges endpoint and challenge model extensions"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm build --filter=@verified-attention/api"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L3
    description: "VERIFY: POST /v1/challenges creates a challenge and returns challengeId"
    verification:
      type: http
      method: POST
      url: http://localhost:3000/v1/challenges
      headers:
        Authorization: "Bearer {{admin_token}}"
      body:
        title: "CTF Challenge"
        description: "Solve this CTF challenge to earn rewards!"
        flags: ["flag{ctf_1}", "flag{ctf_2}"]
      expect:
        status: 201
        json_schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            challengeId: { type: string }
          required: [challengeId]
  - id: L4
    description: "VERIFY: Flags are hidden in proofs"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=hide-flags-in-proofs"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
  - id: L5
    description: "VERIFY: Participants receive rewards for solving challenges"
    verification:
      type: cli
      command: "pnpm test --filter=@verified-attention/api -- --testPathPattern=reward-participants"
      expect:
        exit_code: 0
